sourceRecords.title: Dutch Company Deploys Floating Wind Turbine Prototype for Testing
sourceRecords.sourceText: OffshoreWIND.biz reported that TouchWind installed a floating wind turbine prototype at Fieldlab Green Economy Westvoorne, starting in-water testing for the POWER project. The source states the test campaign will run through 2026 and collect data on turbine performance, platform behaviour and mooring loads.
sourceRecords.licenseNote: Public webpage; source text stored as concise factual evidence for manual archive prototype review.
